title: ai-rulez exposure report
description: Output of `ai-rulez exposure --format json`: what a Claude Code session started at the repository root loads before it touches a file, the skill listing against Claude Code's listing budget, and what waits on demand or for the user. An artifact of phase unknown counts as start in start_tokens, start_tokens_by_kind and listing. See docs/exposure.md.

root.description: The absolute repository root, slash separated.

plugins.description: The repository marketplace as the inventory read it; the skills of the loaded plugins are listed at start.

start_budget.description: The [exposure] start_budget the start tokens were checked against; 0 when there is none. The command exits 2 when start_tokens exceeds a non-zero budget.

listing.description: The start-of-session skill listing against Claude Code's budget: 1% of the context window at 4 characters per token.

context_window.description: The model context window in tokens.

chars.description: Characters of the listing lines of the listed skills.

over_budget_chars.description: chars past budget_chars, 0 when the listing fits.

descriptions_capped.description: Listed skills whose description and when_to_use exceed the per-skill listing cap.

start_tokens.description: Estimated tokens in context at session start.

tokens_by_phase.description: Estimated tokens of every artifact of a phase, if all of them loaded; only phases that have artifacts.

counts_by_phase_and_kind.description: Artifacts per phase and kind; start, on_demand and manual are always present, unknown when an artifact has it.

items.description: Every artifact of the inventory, in inventory order.

name.description: The qualified name: plugin:skill for a plugin skill.

scope.description: The directory that owns the artifact; "." for the root.

area.description: The artifact's area, when an area map is configured or given.
